label: AGV_Current Historizer
info:
Polls AGV_Current[1..5] every 100ms. The function node compares each poll against the previous snapshot in flow.context. If ANY field differs, a full 62-field snapshot is inserted into MySQL — including fields that didn't change within that snapshot.

First read per section is used to seed the baseline and produces no inserts. Strings are preserved exactly as read: trailing spaces and NULs are NOT stripped.

No PLC modification required.

name: READ BEFORE adding a new application
info:
To ensure this works generically across all applications, please follow these rules:

1. Supported data types: DINT, STRING, and REAL only.

2. UDT instance names must exactly match those used in the "Build INSERT or Mapping Query" function node — capitalisation matters.

3. TagName formatting rules:

   • Multiple UDT instances → "TagName.UDTInstance"
     Example: AGV_Current.GantryNo

   • Avoid unsupported characters in TagName before sending.
     The flow auto-replaces them with '__', but cleaner names = fewer issues.

4. Unsupported characters for MySQL identifiers (without backtick quoting):
   . ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) - + = { } [ ] ; : " ' < > , . ? / \ | ~ and whitespace.

5. Table names starting with a digit are auto-prefixed with '_'.

name: Siroflex Table Template
Change Log Table Template
Table CSS Styling
format:
<style>
/* Remove previous odd/even styling or hover effects */
.nrdb-ui-table table tbody tr td {
    background-color: inherit !important;
}

/* Apply alternating color for grouped transaction_id rows */
.nrdb-ui-table table tbody tr.grouped-highlight td {
    background-color: #dceff7 !important; /* Light green */
}
</style>

<script>
(function() {
    function applyTransactionColors() {
        const tables = document.querySelectorAll('.nrdb-ui-table table tbody');
        
        tables.forEach(table => {
            const rows = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('tr'));
            let currentTransactionId = null;
            let highlight = false;

            rows.forEach(row => {
                const transactionCell = row.querySelector('td:first-child');
                if (!transactionCell) return;

                const transactionId = transactionCell.textContent.trim();

                // If transaction ID changes, toggle highlight
                if (transactionId !== currentTransactionId && transactionId !== '') {
                    currentTransactionId = transactionId;
                    highlight = !highlight;
                }

                // Apply or remove highlight class
                if (highlight) {
                    row.classList.add('grouped-highlight');
                } else {
                    row.classList.remove('grouped-highlight');
                }
            });
        });
    }

    // Observe table updates and apply coloring
    const observer = new MutationObserver(applyTransactionColors);
    setTimeout(() => {
        const pageElement = document.querySelector('.nrdb-layout');
        if (pageElement) {
            observer.observe(pageElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        }
        applyTransactionColors();
    }, 500);
})();
</script>
